title: RFID Leather Keyfob — LWG Gold / Cr(VI)-Cleared Premium Hospitality & Residential Credential
summary: RFID leather keyfobs encase an HF or LF inlay inside a stitched full-grain cowhide, vegetable-tanned cowhide, chrome-free cowhide or microfiber PU housing — sourced only from Leather Working Group Gold / Silver audited tanneries with IULTCS / ISO 17226 Cr(VI) ≤ 3 mg/kg clearance, REACH Annex XVII entries 27 + 47 compliance, ZDHC MRSL v3.1 chemistry, OEKO-TEX Leather Standard, CITES-free exotic substitutes, and EU Ecolabel tannery posture. Target use is luxury-residential concierge, 4- / 5-star hospitality arrival kits, private membership clubs, executive automotive / yacht programmes and branded-retail loyalty where the keyfob is the tactile brand artefact on a guest's key-ring.

brief.label: Form factor
items: Rectangle 40 × 30 × 5 mm / teardrop 45 × 28 × 5 mm / rounded-square 35 × 35 × 5 mm; mass 6-12 g with chip and ring.
Two-ply stitched construction: outer grain leather + inner split leather + RFID inlay between; saddle-stitched or lock-stitched edge with polyester / waxed-cotton thread.

brief.label: Leather chemistry — tannage options
items: Chrome-tanned full-grain cowhide (Cr III) from LWG-Gold tannery — most durable, most uniform colour, Cr(VI) kept below IULTCS / ISO 17226 ≤ 3 mg/kg limit.
Vegetable-tanned (bark / mimosa / chestnut) cowhide — patina-forming, chrome-free, preferred by skin-contact-sensitive programmes and the EU Ecolabel route.
Chrome-free / wet-white (aldehyde-tanned, glutaraldehyde or zeolite) cowhide — closes both Cr(III) and Cr(VI) audit lines; OEKO-TEX Leather Standard cleared.
Microfiber PU (polyurethane on polyester non-woven scaffold) — vegan, REACH Annex XVII entries 50 (PAH) + 51 (phthalates) declared; CITES-free for exotic-grain replicas.

brief.label: Chemistry + restricted-substance posture
items: REACH (EC 1907/2006) Annex XVII entry 47 — chromium VI in leather ≤ 3 mg/kg; IULTCS / ISO 17226-1 hot-water extraction + ISO 17226-2 HPLC quantification.
ZDHC MRSL v3.1 — chemical-input restriction list audited at tannery input; REACH SVHC candidate-list screen per hide lot.
OEKO-TEX Leather Standard + Oeko-Tex MADE IN GREEN where end-to-end chain-of-custody is required; EU Ecolabel for leather (Commission Decision 2014/391) where retail posture demands it.
California Prop 65 declaration on chromium / lead / phthalate trace; latex-free, free of PCP (pentachlorophenol) and formaldehyde > 75 ppm.

brief.label: Tannery sourcing audit
items: Leather Working Group (LWG) Gold or Silver rating on the tannery of record — environmental audit covering water, energy, effluent, chemical inputs and traceability.
CITES-free — no exotic-skin substitutes (python, crocodile, alligator, caiman) in the catalogue; embossed cowhide or microfiber PU delivers the visual texture without the CITES burden.

brief.label: Air-interface envelope
items: 13.56 MHz HF — ISO/IEC 14443-3 (MIFARE Plus SE, DESFire EV2 / EV3, NTAG 213 / 215 / 216, NTAG 424 DNA); leather is RF-transparent, tap 3-5 cm.
125 kHz LF — ISO/IEC 18000-2 (EM4200 / EM4305 / T5577 / HID-compatible); tap 5-8 cm matches plastic form factor.

brief.label: Decoration + branding
items: Debossing — heated steel die pressed into the grain; permanent; ~$120 die tooling one-time; 0.5 mm minimum feature.
Foil stamping — debossed impression + gold / silver / rose-gold / copper / PMS foil; wear begins at year 3-5 on pocket-carry daily-duty; legible via underlying impression thereafter.
Laser engraving — 0.2 mm feature; preferred for variable-data serialisation, QR codes, guest-room pairings.
Edge painting + contrast stitching — PMS-matched edge paint and brand-coloured thread deliver the couture finish that hotel and membership programmes specify.

brief.label: Mechanical durability
items: Abrasion: Martindale (ISO 5470-2) ≥ 25,000 cycles on grain-side; colour fastness to rubbing (ISO 11640) ≥ 4 dry / ≥ 3 wet on a 5-point scale.
Stitching: ≥ 40 N tensile per stitch; saddle-stitched variant survives ring-hole tear-out on a 25-key carry for 3-5 years before thread fatigue.

brief.label: Moisture + UV posture
items: Splash-resistant — vegetable- or wet-white-tanned cowhide is not IP-rated and will warp under submersion; specify silicone / epoxy keyfob for pool-adjacent programmes.
UV + light-fastness (ISO 105-B02) ≥ 4 on the blue-wool scale for colour stability under indoor concierge / front-of-house lighting.

brief.label: Use-case envelope
items: Luxury-residential concierge + key-card replacement + amenity access (gym, spa, roof-top, parking).
4- / 5-star hotel arrival kit + room-access credential + long-stay returning-guest loyalty keepsake.
Private membership clubs, executive lounges, co-working premium tiers, branded-retail loyalty and executive-automotive / yacht credentials.

brief.label: Operational lifecycle
items: Typical field life 3-6 years under daily carry — patina is a feature, not a defect; retirement driver is usually thread fatigue or foil wear, not inlay failure.

Retirement: inlay cut out, chip rendered inoperative per NIST SP 800-88; leather body to textile / leather disposal stream (incineration or industrial composting for vegetable-tanned); stainless ring to metal scrap.

brief.label: Attachment + retention
items: 304 / 316 stainless split ring or lobster clasp; plated-steel rings banned (rust / stain grain-side within 6-12 months).
Ring-hole reinforced with a 4-5 mm metal eyelet (brass / stainless) to spread the 25-key-carry load and delay tear-out.

Vegetable-tanned / chrome-free / microfiber-PU tannage options so the same catalogue supports skin-contact-sensitive, vegan, halal / kosher and CITES-free programmes without switching suppliers.

Premium decoration library — debossing (~$120 die), foil stamping (gold / silver / PMS), laser engraving (QR / variable data), edge paint + contrast stitching — tuned for hospitality + residential + membership branding.

sections.title: Why some credentials specifically call for a stitched leather keyfob
bullets: Luxury-residential buildings, private-club concierges and 4- / 5-star hotel arrival kits treat the keyfob as a tactile brand artefact on the guest's key-ring — 6-12 g of full-grain cowhide with foil-stamped branding communicates permanence and prestige that ABS and silicone cannot replicate.

Vegetable-tanned and chrome-free cowhide develops a personal patina over 12-24 months of daily carry — a visual ageing signature that premium audiences actively prize; the keyfob becomes "their" credential rather than a disposable access token.

The Leather Working Group (LWG) Gold audit closes the environmental + water + effluent + traceability diligence line that every premium retail and hospitality brand now expects, and REACH Annex XVII entry 47 (Cr(VI) ≤ 3 mg/kg) closes the skin-contact chemistry audit at IULTCS / ISO 17226 hot-water extraction.

Chrome-free / wet-white tannage (aldehyde or zeolite) + OEKO-TEX Leather Standard + ZDHC MRSL v3.1 delivers a credential usable in halal / kosher / vegan-adjacent programmes and EU Ecolabel retail channels where chrome-tanned leather is no longer welcome.

Microfiber PU on a polyester non-woven scaffold provides a CITES-free, animal-free alternative that mimics exotic grains (python / croc / alligator) with uniform colour, better moisture resistance and REACH Annex XVII entries 50 (PAH) + 51 (phthalates) closed — preferred by vegan-positioned hotel and membership brands.

sections.title: Chrome-tanned vs vegetable-tanned vs chrome-free vs microfiber PU — picking the tannage
bullets: Chrome-tanned (Cr III) full-grain cowhide — most uniform colour, most durable, most scalable; LWG-Gold tannery + Cr(VI) ≤ 3 mg/kg + ZDHC MRSL v3.1 keeps the chemistry audit closed; the industry workhorse for hotel and residential programmes.

Vegetable-tanned cowhide (bark / mimosa / chestnut) — chrome-free, patina-forming, preferred by skin-contact-sensitive programmes and the EU Ecolabel route; 10-20 % more expensive; not colour-uniform hide-to-hide which premium audiences read as authenticity.

Chrome-free / wet-white (aldehyde-tanned or zeolite) cowhide — closes both Cr(III) and Cr(VI) audit lines completely; acceptable for halal / kosher / vegan-adjacent programmes; OEKO-TEX Leather Standard cleared; roughly 15 % cost premium vs chrome-tanned.

Microfiber PU (polyurethane on non-woven polyester) — vegan, CITES-free exotic-grain alternative, uniform colour, more moisture-resistant; REACH Annex XVII entries 50 + 51 + 27 closed; the default for vegan-positioned programmes and higher-volume lower-tier tiers.
All four materials are RF-transparent — chip choice + antenna design drive read range, not tannage; tap is 3-5 cm at HF and 5-8 cm at LF across the catalogue.

before: No Cr(VI) test — fails IULTCS / ISO 17226 on random lot audit; exposure to REACH Annex XVII entry 47 penalty; fails EU retail import check.
No ZDHC MRSL input audit — unknown restricted-substance exposure on azo dyes, chlorinated phenols, formaldehyde, solvent residues.

ZDHC MRSL v3.1 chemistry input + OEKO-TEX Leather Standard tested article + EU Ecolabel tannery posture — the full premium-retail chemistry envelope.

dataHighlight.heading: Chromium VI ceiling on skin-contact leather under REACH Annex XVII entry 47
dataHighlight.text: REACH Annex XVII entry 47 (consolidated 2015-05-01) sets the Cr(VI) ceiling at 3 mg/kg for any leather article with prolonged skin contact — including key-ring items, wristbands and watch straps. The IULTCS / ISO 17226-1 hot-water extraction + ISO 17226-2 HPLC quantification is the regulatory test. All ProudTek leather keyfob lots ship with per-lot Cr(VI) certificates from the LWG-Gold tannery of record; chrome-free wet-white and microfiber PU variants close the test at < 1 mg/kg by construction. EU retail import clearance and CSRD / ESRS scope-3 due-diligence packages reference these certificates directly.
dataHighlight.source: REACH (EC 1907/2006) Annex XVII entry 47 consolidated text, ECHA restriction register, cross-referenced against IULTCS / ISO 17226-1 / -2 test methods and Leather Working Group audit protocol 7.3.1.

sections.title: How to roll out a leather keyfob programme without failing a chemistry, CITES or ESG audit
bullets: Pick the tannage first — chrome-tanned + LWG Gold for volume hospitality; vegetable-tanned for patina-forward luxury; chrome-free / wet-white for halal / kosher / vegan-adjacent; microfiber PU for vegan + CITES-sensitive + exotic-grain replica; each carries a distinct compliance line.

Lock LWG Gold / Silver tannery of record and require the per-lot Cr(VI) certificate (IULTCS / ISO 17226) + ZDHC MRSL v3.1 chemistry-input declaration + OEKO-TEX Leather Standard article-test certificate + REACH SVHC screen; declare all four on the PO.

Don't accept "genuine leather" without a tanning-method statement — chrome-tanned without audit evidence is a non-starter for EU retail; the tannage declaration closes both the import chemistry audit and the vegan / halal / kosher procurement question.

Commission the decoration envelope in the pilot — debossing die (~$120 one-time) for the brand mark, foil stamping (gold / silver / rose-gold / PMS) for the front-of-house artefact, laser engraving for variable-data serialisation, edge paint + contrast stitching for couture finish.

Don't specify CRYPTO-1 MIFARE Classic in a new luxury rollout — pair the leather with MIFARE DESFire EV3 AES-128 or NTAG 424 DNA SUN from day one; leather + broken cipher is the worst of both cost lines.

Order end-of-life logistics — leather fob goes to textile / leather incineration (chrome-tanned) or industrial compost (vegetable-tanned); inlay pulled and chip zeroised per NIST SP 800-88; stainless ring to metal stream.

faq.question: Does the leather housing attenuate the read range?
faq.answer: No — leather (chrome-tanned, vegetable-tanned, chrome-free) and microfiber PU are RF-transparent at both 13.56 MHz HF and 125 kHz LF. Read range matches the same chip in a plastic housing: 3-5 cm tap at HF, 5-8 cm tap at LF. Antenna design and chip drive the range, not the housing. PACS integration, Wiegand / OSDP behaviour and access-control logic are identical to any ABS, epoxy or metal-housing fob.

faq.question: How do you evidence the leather chemistry for EU retail and hotel procurement?
faq.answer: Every production lot ships with a per-lot Cr(VI) certificate (IULTCS / ISO 17226-1 hot-water extraction + ISO 17226-2 HPLC) holding below the REACH Annex XVII entry 47 ≤ 3 mg/kg ceiling, plus a REACH SVHC candidate-list screen, a ZDHC MRSL v3.1 chemistry-input declaration, the OEKO-TEX Leather Standard article-test certificate where specified, and the Leather Working Group (LWG) tannery audit rating (Gold / Silver) on the tannery of record. Chrome-free / wet-white and microfiber PU variants close the chemistry line by construction and are the recommended route for halal / kosher / vegan-adjacent and EU Ecolabel retail programmes.

faq.question: Can we get our brand logo foil-stamped, debossed or laser-engraved on the leather?
faq.answer: Yes — all four decoration methods are supported. Debossing uses a heated steel die (~$120 one-time tooling) pressed into the grain; the impression is permanent and cannot fade or peel. Foil stamping adds gold / silver / rose-gold / copper or PMS foil to the debossed impression; expect 3-5 years of pristine foil on daily-carry duty before minor wear, after which the underlying impression remains fully legible. Laser engraving reaches 0.2 mm feature size and is preferred for variable-data serialisation, QR codes and guest-room pairings. Edge paint + contrast thread complete the couture finish.

faq.question: Should I specify chrome-tanned, vegetable-tanned, chrome-free or microfiber PU for a hotel or residential programme?
faq.answer: Chrome-tanned from an LWG-Gold tannery is the volume default for 4-star hotel and mid-tier residential — uniform colour, most durable, Cr(VI) ≤ 3 mg/kg audit closed per lot. Vegetable-tanned cowhide is the patina-forward luxury route for 5-star hotel and private-club programmes where the keyfob becomes a loyalty artefact. Chrome-free wet-white is the halal / kosher / vegan-adjacent and EU Ecolabel route where chrome tannage is disqualified by policy. Microfiber PU is the vegan + CITES-sensitive + cost-sensitive route and replicates exotic grains without CITES exposure. For pool-adjacent resort properties, skip leather entirely and specify silicone or epoxy — leather is not IP-rated and will warp under sustained moisture.

faq.question: Which chip should we pair with the leather keyfob?
faq.answer: For new luxury-residential or hotel rollouts specify MIFARE DESFire EV3 with AES-128 (ISO/IEC 14443-3, current NXP reference with a published roadmap through 2035+) or NTAG 424 DNA with SUN tap-to-reveal + anti-cloning for mobile-wallet and loyalty integration. For retrofits into buildings already wired for MIFARE Classic, use MIFARE Plus SE in SL1 migration mode (same 4-byte UID so the reader fleet stays intact) and schedule SL3 upgrade within 18 months. Do not commission fresh CRYPTO-1 MIFARE Classic rollouts — the cipher has been publicly broken since 2008 and both NXP and the German BSI recommend migration.
